Katie Price Testifies in Child Rape Trial of Ex-Husband

Reality TV star Katie Price testified in the child rape trial of her ex-husband, stating that she believed the teenager allegedly raped by him was "afraid." Price also told the court that her ex-husband had "done stuff" with other underage children. She declared, "I won't have anybody call me a liar," and mentioned being "handcuffed all week."
